title: Return Rate Measure Used for Box Fees
content:
For shoebox fees on Returns & Exchanges returns, a customer's return rate is measured over the last 12 calendar months, in a way set by the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active.

## Return rate

| Marlowe Rewards membership in status active | Measured by | Return rate |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier | Points | The points taken back by its points reversals, divided by the points its earning and bonus postings gave |
| Silver or Gold | Value | The spend reversed by its points reversals, divided by the qualifying spend of its earning postings |
| Anyone else (Member tier or no active membership) | Count | The number of points reversals posted, divided by the number of Online Orders orders placed |

- All postings and orders are those dated within the last 12 calendar months (postings by posting date, orders by placed date).
- A measure with nothing to divide by is a rate of zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Customer | Ledger and orders in the last 12 calendar months | Return rate |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum | 900 points taken back; 3000 points earned and bonus | 0.3 |
| Gold | 400.00 spend reversed; 1600.00 qualifying spend | 0.25 |
| Member tier | 3 reversals; 5 orders placed | 0.6 |
| Silver | 120.00 spend reversed; no earning postings | 0 (nothing to divide by) |
